You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 9f0fedcb44da5efc41a5f36fc8f7dc6ecd3647d7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jeremy Mikola <jmikola@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Dec 2016 12:53:43 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] Only fetch TSRMLS for 32-bit platforms in int64 visitor

This fixes a build error introduced in be58940cd9c1373dad97d0e4364e4b61881022b2.
---
 src/bson.c | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/bson.c b/src/bson.c
index 1b5c95e4..5844bea9 100644
--- a/src/bson.c
+++ b/src/bson.c
@@ -530,7 +530,9 @@ bool php_phongo_bson_visit_int64(const bson_iter_t *iter ARG_UNUSED, const char
 #else
 	zval *retval = ((php_phongo_bson_state *)data)->zchild;
 #endif
+#if SIZEOF_PHONGO_LONG == 4
 	TSRMLS_FETCH();
+#endif
 
 	ADD_ASSOC_INT64(retval, key, v_int64);
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect attempt to fetch the Thread-Safe Resource Manager Local Storage (TSRMLS) on platforms where the size of a long integer is not 4 bytes (i.e., 64-bit platforms). The original code did not conditionally include the TSRMLS_FETCH() call based on the platform's architecture, leading to a build error on 64-bit systems. The patch corrects this by ensuring that TSRMLS_FETCH() is only called on 32-bit platforms, where the size of a long is 4 bytes.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect attempt to fetch the Thread-Safe Resource Manager Local Storage (TSRMLS) on platforms where the size of a long integer is not 4 bytes (i.e., 64-bit platforms). The original code did not conditionally include the TSRMLS_FETCH() call based on the platform's architecture, leading to a build error on 64-bit systems. The patch corrects this by ensuring that TSRMLS_FETCH() is only called on 32-bit platforms, where the size of a long is 4 bytes.
